描述_ZN: Ink Painting of Plum Blossoms, Qing dynasty, painted by Li Fang Ying, on paper with ink brush, 125.6 cm in length and 42.9 cm in width.　　The inscription reads: "For ten days, when the cooking is broken, the ancient plum is soothed by a few strokes. Ice flowers and snow pistil are a common meal, and a belly full of spring breeze is never hungry. Written in October of the nineteenth year of the Qianlong reign in the Borrowed Garden in Jinling. Li Fang Ying." Inscriptions: "Dream in a Dream", "Change Rice for Livelihood", "Ying", "Means of Plum Blossoms", "Wind and Rain in a Small Window", etc, "Small Window and Storm" and so on. The Seal of Identification and Collection Inscription "Chu Zhen". The nineteenth year of the Qianlong reign was 1754. Li Fang Ying sold paintings for a living after his dismissal from the government and lived in poverty, and the poem inscribed in the painting reflects his optimistic spirit of enduring hunger to paint.　　The ancients painted plum, or thousands of flowers, or withered branches and sparse, most of the plum tree branches gnarled, shaking and posture. Li Fang Ying loved to paint plum, and once inscribed a poem on painting plum: "It may not be appropriate to write about plum, no wonder the ink is late in front of the flower. There are only two or three stems that can be appreciated while there are millions of flowers across the eyes." From the tens of millions of plum blossoms, the painter captured the most pleasing two or three branches, and through artistic conception, created a more perfect artistic image than the natural plum blossoms, with less than more, evocative. Zheng Banqiao praised this.　　In the picture, the folded plum blossoms have strong personality characteristics, plum branches "bold and horizontal", round and dashing plum blossoms, dark fragrance and shadow, a unique high and cold demeanor. Li Fang Ying's friend Yuan Mei said of his plum: "The proud bones of the plum tree, the roots of the plum tree, the talent scattered as the flowers of the plum tree", a word to explain the reason for his style. Li Fang Ying's love of plum became a fetish, so he had the seal of "his soulmate in life", and he used the painting of plum as a metaphor for his straightforward, stubborn and righteous personality, "the lonely stem invites the wind of heaven and earth, the fragrant heart does not die under the frost".
